diagnostics.message: Code-derived transition constraint must cite a selected binding

current_value.constraint: Three distinct IDs and indexes 0..3, with startIndex independently selected from the same range.
current_value.justification: A finite search bound covering zero, single, even and odd voter counts, threshold failures, multiple advancements, stale reports and voter removal/reintroduction. It does not establish results for larger populations or uint64 extremes.

current_value.constraint: Normalize reports for absent IDs to zero while retaining voter membership separately.
current_value.justification: Absent map lookups yield zero; hasVote separately controls match acceptance. setConfiguration copies only currently retained map entries, so removal and reintroduction cannot recover an old report.

current_value.constraint: Project completed methods atomically with respect to the protected map and commitIndex.
current_value.justification: match, setConfiguration and getCommitIndex hold the same mutex. No other selected operation can observe partial map replacement or recalculation. Waiting, notification internals and incomplete calls are hidden; no termination or notification guarantee is asserted.

current_value.constraint: Preserve commitIndex across voter-set replacement unless recalculation increases it.
current_value.justification: setConfiguration replaces matchIndexes but does not reset commitIndex. The checker requires current-voter support only at advancement events.

current_value.constraint: Numeric reports and voter subsets are arbitrary local API inputs within the finite bounds.
current_value.justification: The selected scope deliberately separates local arithmetic from legal cluster histories. No report truth, membership legality or election validity is assumed.
